sense: deserve by what one has done

evidence: Cic. Fam. 10.17.3: sī mereor, if I deserve it (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The active mereō is used in the same sense (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: quod, inquit, ergō, stulte, meruistī decus, minus valentem sī vīcistī fortior?
phrases.english: “Then what honour have you earned, you fool,” he said, “if you, the stronger, beat a weaker man?”

sources: Lewis & Short: mereo
